target.title: fix(doctor): bound legacy session store read with size cap and stat-failure fix
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`readLegacySessionRecords` in `src/commands/doctor-session-sqlite.ts` reads legacy session store SQLite files with `fs.readFileSync` and no size limit. A corrupted or maliciously large store file would OOM the doctor process.

## Why This Change Was Made

A function reading arbitrary file paths from session store targets should not allocate unbounded memory. Doctor processes run during user-initiated diagnosis — the last place a user expects an OOM crash.

## What Changed

Added a `statSync` pre-check with a 50 MiB size cap before each store file read. When `statSync` returns `undefined` (file not found) and `allowMissingStore` is true, the code now checks whether the parent path is a directory to correctly distinguish ENOENT from ENOTDIR (parent path is a file), which previously caused a crash.

## Evidence

**All 70 tests pass (68 passed + 2 skipped):**

```
[test] queued behind the local heavy-check lock held by test, pid 1082097, cwd /home/0668000387/openclawCxbAsDev...
[test] starting test/vitest/vitest.commands.config.ts

 RUN  v4.1.10 /home/0668000387/openclawCxbAsDev/.worktrees/pr-batch

 ✓ |commands| src/commands/doctor-session-sqlite.test.ts (70 tests | 2 skipped) 10879ms
     ✓ migrates a dormant historical agent database before all-agent import compaction  333ms
     ✓ compacts migrated agent SQLite databases and reports reclaimed pages  564ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  68 passed | 2 skipped (70)
   Start at  10:03:54
   Duration  24.71s (transform 10.91s, setup 1.20s, import 12.32s, tests 10.88s, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 37.73s
```

50 MiB is above any legitimate session store file — typical stores are under 1 MiB. The cap prevents OOM on corrupted or malformed inputs while keeping normal operation unchanged.

## Changes

- Added `statSync` pre-check with 50 MiB size cap in `readLegacySessionRecords`
- Added parent-directory validation for `allowMissingStore === true` to distinguish ENOTDIR from ENOENT
- Tests cover: normal read, oversized rejection, missing store, non-directory parent path
